reviewed_evidence: spatial_encoding_audit/review_1.png and review_2.png; four original-image activation overlays per dimension, Top10 heatmap morphology and across-city x-position stability
rule: At least 8 of Top10 maps contain a >=17-patch vertical band; band center SD <=1 patch, positive response in >=2000 fixed-validation panoramas and examples from >=6 cities. Visual review excludes moving object-aligned stripes.
interpretation: Response is dominated by a stable vertical image-coordinate band across diverse visual content. This is a positional-artifact candidate, not a demonstrated internal positional-embedding mechanism. SAE activations and raw Qwen labels are retained.
